recipe.name: pancakes
steps: Combine flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt together into a bowl. Add liquids and egg, mix until smooth.
Lightly oil a shallow pain and heat to meduim-high. Pour 1/4C of batter in per pancake, cook until top is bubbling and edges are dry.
When toast has finsished toasting, place onto one slice of bread and top with the other slice.
Flip, and cook until browned on bottom, check with toothpick if uncertain.
Serve while hot, butter and syrup optional.
